messages:
sara: Quick All-Hands follow-up on hybrid/remote and offsite travel. I'll capture confirmed items here. Drop other Qs and we'll update the FAQ. :sparkles:

maya: If a manager wants a recurring team day (e.g., every 2nd Thursday), do they need org approval?

sara: Managers set team norms. Post to your team calendar and notify your GM if it affects other teams or shared spaces.

josh: Any change to commuter/parking stipends? Heard a pilot was ending.

sara: Right 1 the SF/Denver commuter pilots end this quarter. We'll evaluate expansion; we'll give 30 days' notice before changes. Case-by-case reviews for recurring parking needs.

emily: Offsite logistics: visa letters and reimbursement?

sara: People Ops issues invitation letters for company-sponsored events. Visa fees reimbursed if pre-approved on the travel request form (use the "visa_support" field).

ops-bot: Reminder: submit travel requests at least 21 days for domestic and 30 days for international travel to allow booking and visa processing.

maya: Childcare/partner policy for offsites?

sara: We're piloting a limited childcare/partner stipend for select 2026 offsites. Details and eligibility will be on the travel page; managers can request exceptions.

josh: Who approves schedule or budget exceptions?

sara: Operational exceptions = manager + People Ops; budget exceptions escalate to Finance + GM.

emily: ADA accommodations? Confidential process?

sara: Contact People Ops privately and we'll arrange accommodations confidentially.

sara: Action items: 1) Update the hybrid/remote FAQ by next Tue. 2) Publish offsite booking checklist and vendor list. 3) Add childcare stipend pilot details. I'll post links here when live.
